name: Grow Therapy vs SonderMind
title: Grow Therapy vs SonderMind: Therapist Network Comparison 2026
description: Compare Grow Therapy and SonderMind provider networks for therapists. See credentialing speed, features, VA coverage, and which platform is best for building your practice.

summary.bottom_line: Both Grow Therapy and SonderMind are free-to-join therapist networks with comprehensive payer coverage. Grow Therapy offers the fastest credentialing (5-7 days), guaranteed claims, and included practice management tools. SonderMind offers VA partnership (100% covered for veterans) and Medicare acceptance. Choose Grow for speed and practice tools, SonderMind for veteran and Medicare clients.

sections.heading: Grow Therapy vs SonderMind: Overview
sections.content: Grow Therapy and SonderMind are both free-to-join therapist networks that handle insurance credentialing, billing, and payments. Grow Therapy, founded in 2020 in New York, has grown to 19,000+ providers and differentiates with the fastest credentialing (5-7 days), guaranteed claims, and comprehensive practice management tools including EHR, AI documentation, and telehealth. SonderMind, founded in 2017 in Denver, differentiates with VA partnership (100% covered for veterans), Medicare acceptance, and continuing education resources.

sections.heading: Provider Economics
sections.content: Both platforms are free for therapists with revenue sharing models. Grow Therapy takes a percentage of insurance reimbursements but doesn't disclose exact splits - providers don't always receive full transparency on insurer-to-Grow payments. Reimbursement rates range from $60-160+ per session depending on CPT code, payer, credentials, and location. SonderMind advertises premium in-network rates and same-day payment options. Both pay weekly/bi-weekly with Grow guaranteeing claims.

sections.heading: Platform Capabilities
sections.content: Grow Therapy includes more practice management tools: EHR, scheduling, secure messaging, AI-assisted documentation, and integrated telehealth - all free. SonderMind offers basic scheduling and telehealth but emphasizes provider directory for client matching and continuing education resources. Grow's 5-7 day credentialing is the fastest in the industry - SonderMind's timeline varies by payer. SonderMind has mobile apps; Grow is web-only.

sections.heading: Specialized Coverage
sections.content: SonderMind's VA partnership is a significant differentiator - veterans with valid referrals receive 100% VA-covered therapy in all 50 states at no cost. SonderMind also accepts Medicare and Medicare Advantage, which Grow Therapy does not. For therapists wanting to serve veterans or Medicare clients, SonderMind is the clear choice. Both cover major commercial payers.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Consider your client population and needs:

recommendations.when: You want the fastest credentialing (5-7 days) and comprehensive free practice management tools including EHR and AI documentation
You want to serve veterans (100% VA covered) or Medicare/Medicare Advantage clients
You value guaranteed claims and weekly payments with no risk of denied claim complications
You want a mobile app and continuing education resources through your network
You can join multiple networks to maximize client access - both are free

faqs.q: Which has faster credentialing: Grow Therapy or SonderMind?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy has significantly faster credentialing at 5-7 days average - one of the fastest in the industry. SonderMind's credentialing timeline varies by payer and isn't as specifically advertised.

faqs.q: Can I see veterans through SonderMind?
faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind is an in-network VA provider. Veterans with valid VA referrals receive 100% covered therapy at no cost. This is available in all 50 states. Grow Therapy does not have VA partnership.

faqs.q: Does Grow Therapy include practice management tools?
faqs.a: Yes, Grow Therapy includes comprehensive free practice management: EHR, scheduling, secure messaging, AI-assisted documentation, and integrated telehealth. This is unusual for a free platform.

faqs.q: What are Grow Therapy reimbursement rates?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy rates range from $60-160+ per session depending on CPT code, payer, credentials, and location. PMHNPs average ~$129/hour while LCSWs earn $85-100/session. Exact splits aren't always transparent.
